# 4 Ezra Chapter 1 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** 5th Ezra (Christian addition)

---

**1** God's word came to Ezra, son of Saraias — whose lineage ran back through Azarias, Helkias, Salemas, Sadoc, and Achitob,

**2** through Achias, Phinees, Heli, Amarias, Aziei, Marimoth, Arna, Ozias, Borith, Abisei, Phinees, all the way to Eleazar,

**3** son of Aaron himself, of the tribe of Levi — Ezra who lived as an exile in Media during the reign of the Persian king Artaxerxes.

**4** And this is what the LORD said to me:

**5** Go and confront my people with their crimes. Tell their children too — the long list of wrongs they have done against me — so the story gets passed to their grandchildren.

**6** The sins of their fathers have multiplied in them. They forgot me. They sacrificed to alien gods.

**7** Wasn't it I who pulled them out of Egypt — out of that house of slavery? And yet they enraged me and threw my counsel in my face.

**8** Tear out your hair and heap every curse on them — they have refused my law. They are a people of rebellion.

**9** How much longer must I put up with them, after everything I did for them? I toppled kingdoms on their behalf. I struck down Pharaoh, his court, his entire army.

**10** I wiped out nation after nation before their advance. In the east I smashed the people of Tyre and Sidon and cut down every enemy in their path.

**11** So go and say to them: Here is what the LORD declares:

**12** I personally walked you through the sea. I built you roads when there were none. I gave you Moses to lead you and Aaron to serve as your priest.

**13** I lit your nights with a pillar of fire. I worked wonders right before your eyes. And still you forgot me. The LORD has spoken.

**14** The LORD Almighty says this: The quails I sent were a gift. I set up camp around you like an armed guard. And you grumbled anyway.

**15** Not once did you win a victory in my name over your enemies. You are still complaining to this day.

**16** Where is your gratitude for my kindness? When you were starving and dying of thirst in the desert, did you not cry out to me —

**17** saying: Why did you drag us out here to die? We would have been better off as Egyptian slaves than rotting in this wasteland.

**18** Your suffering broke my heart, so I gave you manna — the bread of angels — to eat.

**19** When you were parched, I split open the rock and water poured out. When the heat was unbearable, I canopied you with forest leaves.

**20** I parcelled out rich farmland for you. I drove out the Canaanites, the Perizzites, and the Philistines — cleared them all out ahead of you. What else could I possibly have done? The LORD asks this.

**21** The LORD Almighty speaks again: At the bitter river in the wilderness, when you were thirsty and cursing my name —

**22** I did not strike you down for your blasphemy. Instead I threw a branch into the water and made it drinkable.

**23** What am I to do with you, Jacob? With you, Judah, who won't listen? I am going to turn to other nations. I will give them my name, and they will honour my laws.

**24** You abandoned me, so I am abandoning you. When you beg for mercy, I will not give it.

**25** When you call out to me I will not answer — because you have blood on your hands and murder in your steps.

**26** It is not just me you have forsaken — you have abandoned yourselves. The LORD declares it.

**27** The LORD Almighty says: Did I not plead with you like a father with his children, like a mother with her daughters, like a nurse coaxing her little ones —

**28** begging you to be my people while I would be your God, to be my children while I would be your father?

**29** I gathered you the way a mother hen gathers her chicks under her wings. So now what is left for me to do? I will throw you away from my presence.

**30** Bring me your offerings if you like — I will look away. Your festivals, your new moon celebrations, your ritual circumcisions — I want none of it.

**31** I sent you my servants, the prophets, and you killed them. You butchered their bodies. That blood — I am holding you responsible. The LORD has spoken.

**32** The LORD Almighty declares: Your house is empty. I will scatter you the way the wind scatters straw.

**33** Your children will bear no fruit because they ignored my commands and acted wickedly against me.

**34** I am giving your homes to a nation yet unborn — people who never heard my voice but will trust me anyway, who never saw my miracles but will obey my commands.

**35** They never knew the prophets, yet they will honour their memory. I am entrusting them with what the first people threw away. They will be my people, and their leaders will have an eternal covenant with me.

**36** Their children will love me and I will show them what salvation looks like. They have received my Holy Spirit, and I will tell them things that last forever.

**37** So do not mourn those rejected nations — since they refused to obey me, their names will not appear in the book of life.
